steps.name: Scout 5 cm / 5 uL-min
steps.confirm_message: evagreen: confirm oil is routed through M1 (channel 1). Set outlet 5 cm ABOVE the current reservoir oil surface (scout). Confirm only when this height is measured and correct; keep it constant during this sweep. Abort for unexpected pressure or unstable flow. Zero flow may retain pressure; verify no oil-column retreat.
